question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Officious
solution:
The correct answer is '**Timid**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Officious** means excessively eager to offer unsolicited advice or opinions.
 
• **Timid** means showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened.
 
• The two words have opposite meanings, making **Option 4 the correct antonym.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other options:
 
 
• Option 1: **Obtrusive** means noticeable or prominent in an unwelcome or intrusive way.
 
• Option 2: **Legal** means relating to the law or to lawyers.
 
• Option 3: **Imperial** means relating to an empire or its ruler.
